arabic text: (KAHAN JAAYE AAKHIR BAYABAAN HAR SOO\nSHIKASTA HAI PEHLU AKELI HAI ZEHRA)..(3)
english translation text: Where can she go? There is wilderness on every side.\nHer side is broken, and Zahra is alone.

arabic text: (RONE PE PEHRA MASAYAB KA SEHRA\nAKELI HAI ZEHRA)..(2)
english translation text: Her weeping is guarded, and her calamities form a desert.\nZahra is alone.

arabic text:
(DAR E FATEMA KO JALAYA HAI TUMNE
KIYA WAADA APNA BHULAYA HAI TUMNE)..(2)
TAMAACHE NA MAARO MUSALMAANO JAAO
ALI KO BULAAO AKELI HAI ZEHRA
english translation text:
You burned Fatima's door
and forgot the promise you had made.
Do not strike her with slaps, O Muslims—go!
Call Ali; Zahra is alone.

arabic text:
(BAYAA'N KISSE JAAKAR KAROON DARD APNA
HAI GHAIRON KI DUNIYA NAHI KOI APNA)..(2)
KOI JAAKE BABA SE KEH DO YE JAAKAR
KE LE JAAO AAKAR AKELI HAI ZEHRA
english translation text:
To whom can I go and describe my pain?
This is a world of strangers; no one here is mine.
Someone go and tell Baba:
come and take me away—Zahra is alone.

arabic text:
(AE LAKHTE JIGAR AE HASAN IBNE HAIDER
YE NANA KE PEHLU ME SONE NA DE GAR)..(2)
TUM AA JANA PEHLU ME SO JANA MAA KE
BAQI ME YAHAN PAR AKELI HAI ZEHRA
english translation text:
O piece of my heart, Hasan son of Haider,
if they do not let me sleep beside your grandfather,
then come and sleep beside your mother
here in Baqi, where Zahra is alone.

arabic text:
(SHAHE KARBALA NE KAHA ROKE MAA'N SE
YE MAZLOOM BETE NE MAZLOOM MAA'N SE)..(2)
AKELA HOON MAIN BHI AKELI HAIN ZAINAB
AKELE HAIN BABA AKELI HAIN ZEHRA
english translation text:
The King of Karbala wept and said to his mother—
this oppressed son to his oppressed mother:
I too am alone; Zainab is alone;
Baba is alone, and Zahra is alone.

arabic text:
(SARE MARG AKHTAR THA ZEHRA KA NAUHA
KAB AAOGE MAHDI KAB AAOGE BETA)..(2)
KHUDA KE LIYE AB YE PARDA HATA DO
CHALE AAO AAO AKELI HAI ZEHRANOHA AUDIOBOOK
english translation text:
At the final breath, Akhtar recited Zahra's lament:
when will you come, Mahdi? When will you come, my son?
For God's sake, now lift this veil.
Come—come, for Zahra is alone.
